claims.sentence: Given the importance of ASA, we tested whether ASA may be able to regulate tumor angiogenesis.</jats:p> <jats:p>Methods: To do so, we determined the effect of low dose ASA (1mM, which is equivalent to 80mg human dose), ASA-treated (2.5mM) conditioned media (231-CMASA) or vehicle-treated conditioned media (231-CMVT) of MDA-MB-231 cells on different endothelial cell physiology.
